name: quorum
description: Pool several AI subscriptions inside Claude Code by delegating to vendor CLIs as subprocesses. Ships field-tested adapters for GLM (Z.AI), Codex (ChatGPT), Copilot, Antigravity (Gemini) and Ollama (local), a multi-model consultation panel, task delegation into throwaway worktrees you review as a diff, and a probe-driven generator that builds and verifies an adapter for any provider you already have.
